page.overview:
Who is Dale?

In Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Dale is one of 's classmates.

Dale is a teenage caucasian boy with black eyes, light skin, and a thin figure. He wears a sweater with a light green torso and dark green sleeves, red jeans, and white sneakers.

In Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Movie, he wore a dark red sweater and brown pants.

Dale is an outcast in Washington Irving High School. He is shown to be somewhat annoying, even to (his presumed crush), who wants little to do with him. Dale is also eager to become a cool kid to impress Taylor Martin, after being convinced to download the Hippo Crush mobile app.
